biotools.summary: The Genome of Slovakia Population Browser is an interactive tool for exploring genetic variation in the Slovak population, based on whole-genome sequencing data from >1000 individuals. It enables users to search genomic variants, examine their allele frequencies and distribution within the cohort, and compare population-specific observations with international reference datasets. The browser supports research, clinical variant interpretation, and the identification of variants that may be common, rare, or potentially specific to the Slovak population.
